name: ProLectric, LLC
summary: A family-owned, veteran-operated electrical contractor in Dickinson, Texas, serving Galveston County and the southern edges of Harris and Brazoria Counties.
sameDay: Our phones are answered live by really nice people, and same day service is usually available.

hero.title: Need electrical work done right?
hero.lead: A family-owned, veteran-operated electrical contractor with licensed electricians on staff — no subcontractors, ever. We send a qualified, background-checked, drug-free electrician to look at the work and give you an upfront price.
hero.imageAlt: A ProLectric electrician installing a chandelier in a home

groups.title: Panels & Service
groups.summary: Panel upgrades, meter and service work, surge protection and the permits that go with them.
groups.intro: Electrical panel changes are one of our specialties. Your panel installation is designed and configured for your home and its power usage, and our licensed electricians follow all city, state and national electric code guidelines. We take pride in upgrading even the oldest panels and wiring systems.
groups.imageAlt: A new electrical panel with a surge protector and generator interlock fitted

services.title: Electrical Panel Replacement
services.text: We offer three brands of electrical panel — GE, Cutler/Hammer and Square D — and our electricians will help you decide which is the best choice for your home. Panel warranties range from one year to lifetime depending on the brand.
points: Flickering lights, tripping breakers or power surges
Popping or sizzling noises from the panel
The panel feels hot or you can smell overheated wires
Arc fault protection, GFCI protection, main grounding and surge protection included where needed

services.title: Insurance Required Panel Change
services.text: Texas insurers are asking homeowners to replace panels made by Federal Pacific, Stab-Lok, Sylvania, Challenger and Zinsco. We change them out to a current, code-compliant panel.
points: Consider a replacement if your home is over 20 years old or you are adding high-power appliances

services.title: Electrical Service & Meter Work
services.text: Service changes cover everything between the utility and your panel, from the meter can to the grounding system.
points: Meter loops and meter can replacement
Service entrance cables and underground services

services.title: Service Riser Repair
services.text: Service mast and riser repair for homes in Dickinson and the surrounding area, including the electric service poles and temporary power poles that go with new work.
points: Sub panels and breaker change outs

services.title: Whole House Surge Protection
services.text: A whole home surge protector is installed at the electrical panel to help reduce damaging voltage spikes before they travel through the home. Some are fitted inside the panel and others mounted externally beside it, depending on the existing equipment.
points: Protects hardwired equipment a plug-in surge strip cannot
Helps protect appliances, televisions, computers, routers and garage door openers
Installed at the panel by a licensed electrical contractor

services.title: Electrical Panel Tune-Up
services.text: A comprehensive inspection and maintenance service for your home's electrical panel: $89 per panel, and commercial panel inspections are quoted on a call.
points: Checked for loose connections, damaged wiring and overheating
Connections secured and all circuits tested

services.title: Power Restoration & Permitting
services.text: If you have no power, our electricians can replace your electrical panel today and in most cases have you back up and running the very same day. We handle the permits the work needs.
points: Same day panel replacement in most cases

groups.title: Repairs & Troubleshooting
groups.summary: Breakers that trip, outlets with no power, flickering lights and the inspections that find them.
groups.intro: If you have a breaker that keeps tripping, an outlet without power, flickering lights or a circuit that suddenly stopped working, the cause usually cannot be determined just by looking at it. An electrician may need to test the circuit, trace wiring, inspect connections and check breakers to find what is actually causing the problem. Once we know, we explain what we found and give you a price before proceeding.
groups.imageAlt: A replaced meter can carrying a city inspection tag

services.title: Electrical Repair & Troubleshooting
services.text: Diagnostic work on the circuit itself rather than an estimate, with a clear, upfront flat-rate price before any repair begins.
points: The problem and the cost of repairing it explained before we start

services.title: Tripping Breakers
services.text: A tripping breaker is a safety mechanism, usually caused by an overloaded circuit, a short circuit or a ground fault. If yours trips repeatedly, do not keep resetting it — have the circuit inspected.
points: Load evaluated before new circuits are added

services.title: GFCI & Arc Fault Protection
services.text: If a GFCI outlet will not reset it is usually a ground fault, where electricity is escaping the circuit, or the outlet itself has failed. We replace failed devices and add the protection modern code requires.

services.title: Outlets & Dedicated Circuits
services.text: New outlets can usually be added to an existing circuit, but only once the load has been checked. Our master electricians evaluate your current load and install to current building codes.
points: Cable TV outlets and phone jacks

services.title: Smoke Detector Replacement
services.text: Hardwired smoke detectors replaced throughout the home, along with bath fan and vent hood wire-ups.

services.title: Home Electrical Inspections
services.text: Pre-purchase electrical inspections for a home you are buying, and general home electrical inspections for one you already own.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Service
services.text: Repair, troubleshooting, lighting and panel work for businesses throughout Dickinson, League City, Pearland, Pasadena and the surrounding areas.
points: Exit sign replacement and new LED emergency exit lighting
Emergency lighting repairs, including battery backup failures
Breaker panel repairs and commercial electrical maintenance

groups.title: Lighting & Fans
groups.summary: Fixtures, fans, recessed and under-counter lighting, and landscape lighting outside.
groups.intro: From hanging a new chandelier in the grand entryway to running LED landscape lighting across the yard, lighting is everyday work for our electricians. We install fixtures, fans and circuits in homes and businesses across Galveston County.
groups.imageAlt: Pendant lights installed over a kitchen area in a home

services.title: Ceiling Fan Installation
services.text: Ceiling fans installed and replaced, including the boxes and circuits that support them.

services.title: Chandelier & Fixture Installation
services.text: Chandeliers, pendants and lighting fixtures hung and wired, including high entryway work.

services.title: Recessed & Under Counter Lighting
services.text: Recessed lighting laid out and installed room by room, with under counter and under cabinet lighting in kitchens.

services.title: LED Landscape Lighting
services.text: LED landscape lighting and low voltage lighting designed around the yard and the house.

services.title: Outdoor & Security Lighting
services.text: Outdoor lighting for the drive, the yard and the waterfront, including barn lights and security lighting.

groups.title: EV Charging & Backup Power
groups.summary: EV chargers, Tesla Wall Connectors, generator interlocks, RV and garage circuits.
groups.intro: ProLectric is a Tesla Wall Connector Approved Electrician and installs home and commercial EV charging throughout Galveston County and the Bay Area Houston area. We also fit generator interlock systems so a portable generator can safely power your home when the lights go out.
groups.imageAlt: A generator inlet box and an EV charger installed on the side of a brick house

services.title: EV Charger Installation
services.text: We install dedicated circuits, 240V outlets, wall-mounted chargers and complete charging station setups for a wide range of electric vehicle brands and charger manufacturers.
points: Level 2 charging on a dedicated 240V circuit
Level 1 outlets inspected for safe charging capability
Autel, ChargePoint, Emporia and JuiceBox chargers installed

services.title: Tesla Wall Connector Installation
services.text: As a Tesla Wall Connector Approved Electrician, we evaluate your panel, available capacity, wiring run and charger location, then install the connector and the electrical equipment a safe, code-compliant installation needs.
points: Panel capacity and load evaluated first

services.title: Commercial EV Charging Stations
services.text: Level 2 commercial charging for offices, retail centers, apartments and commercial properties, with the panel upgrades and disconnects that go with them.
points: Panel upgrades, dedicated circuits and disconnects

services.title: Generator Interlock Installation
services.text: A generator interlock is a safety device fitted in your electrical panel so a portable generator can be connected directly to your home. It stops the main breaker and the generator breaker being on at the same time, which eliminates dangerous backfeeding.
points: Interlock device fitted in your panel
Proper breaker and wiring, with a clean conduit run outside
You choose what runs: air conditioning, refrigerator and freezer, lights and outlets, WiFi and essential electronics

services.title: Transfer Switch Installation
services.text: A transfer switch is what lets a backup generator be connected to your electrical system safely, and it is the barrier that stops electricity feeding back into the utility lines. We fit manual switches for portable generators and automatic switches for permanent standby generators.
points: Manual transfer switches for a portable generator
Automatic transfer switches that detect the outage, start the generator and switch the load back when utility power returns
Essential circuits identified and running and startup wattage calculated, so the switch and the generator are sized to match
30 amp, 50 amp and higher ratings, and service entrance rated switches where that is the right fit
Switches and inlet boxes installed outdoors in NEMA 3R or better enclosures
Permits and inspections handled, and advice on safe generator placement

services.title: RV & Garage Circuits
services.text: RV electrical hookups, garage circuits and hot tub or spa circuits, sized and run for the load they have to carry.

about.title: A family business in Dickinson, seventeen years in.
text: We started the business in April of 2009 under the name Beacon Electrical Service. About a year in we got a letter from another company using the same name, which had been reserved in the State of Texas. They were really kind to us and gave us time to find another one, and in March of 2010 we chose ProLectric, LLC.

In August of 2013 we moved out of the home office into a 2,000 square foot office building in Dickinson, Texas. In 2018 our son Jacob Bankston graduated high school and came to work full time in the business; he got his Journeyman's license in 2022 and is studying for his master license now.

Over these 17 years we have gained a large following of loyal customers who refer us to friends, neighbors and business associates. We look forward to having you as our life long customer. — James & Kathy Bankston, Owners
about.imageAlt: Jimmy Bankston, Master Electrician and owner of ProLectric, in front of a company van

facts.text: Military, veterans and senior citizens 65 and up save 10%, up to $100, on any service. The discount has to be requested at the time of service and mentioned before the job is invoiced, as there are no refunds or discounts once a service has been invoiced out. Limit one coupon per customer per visit, and it is not combinable.

facts.heading: Call us right away if you have
items: A power outage or a partial loss of power
Sparking or buzzing from a panel or an outlet

facts.heading: Turning the power back on at a vacant home
facts.text: If a home has sat vacant with the electricity off, the utility needs a whole home electrical inspection before power can go back on. We inspect the system against current code and, where it does not meet it, give you a written estimate to bring it up to code so it can pass the city inspection. The process usually takes three days: our electrical inspection on day one, the city inspection on day two and the utility reconnecting on day three. Repairs add time.

facts.heading: Estimates and pricing
facts.text: An estimate is based on what can be seen at the time it is given, so the price can change if additional work, hidden damage, code issues, unsafe wiring, access problems or material changes turn up. A written estimate is valid for the period stated on it.

facts.heading: Permits, inspections and payment
facts.text: Some electrical work needs a permit and an inspection, and we follow the local requirements where it does. Permit fees, inspection fees and utility company fees may be added to the cost of the project unless we have said otherwise in writing. Payment is due on the terms stated on your invoice, estimate or service agreement, and on larger jobs we may ask for a deposit or progress payments.

facts.heading: Workmanship warranty
facts.text: We stand behind the workmanship on completed electrical work. Coverage varies by job, and it does not extend to customer-supplied materials, existing wiring and equipment, misuse, acts of nature, water damage, power surges, utility problems or work done by others. Materials and equipment carry the manufacturer's own warranty on the manufacturer's terms.

facts.heading: Appointment texts
facts.text: If you give us your mobile number we may text you about appointments, estimates, project updates and scheduling. Message frequency varies and carrier rates may apply. Reply STOP to any message to opt out, or HELP for assistance. Consenting to texts is never a condition of having work done, and we do not share mobile information with third parties for marketing.

faqs.q: Do you have an electrician near me?
faqs.a: ProLectric provides professional electrical services across the entire Bay Area Houston region. With licensed electricians based throughout Dickinson, League City and Alvin, we are often in your neighborhood and can frequently offer same-day service for urgent repairs.

faqs.q: Can I add a new outlet to an existing circuit?
faqs.a: Yes, but it must be done safely to avoid overloading the circuit. Our master electricians can evaluate your current load and install a new outlet (receptacle) that meets modern building codes, including GFCI protection where required.

faqs.q: Why won't my GFCI outlet reset?
faqs.a: If a GFCI outlet won't reset, it is usually due to a ground fault where electricity is escaping the circuit, or the outlet itself has failed. First, check your main breaker panel. If the breaker is on, the outlet may need professional replacement to ensure your home remains protected from electrical shock.

faqs.q: Does ProLectric give free estimates for electrical work?
faqs.a: We offer free estimates for planned electrical additions and installations, such as adding outlets, installing EV chargers, or adding a panel or a subpanel. Free estimates do not apply to troubleshooting, repair calls or panel replacements. For repair work where troubleshooting is required (like a tripping breaker), we provide a clear, upfront flat-rate price before any work begins.

faqs.q: Why does my circuit breaker keep tripping?
faqs.a: A tripping breaker is a safety mechanism usually caused by an overloaded circuit, a short circuit, or a ground fault. If your breaker trips repeatedly, do not continue to reset it; this can lead to a fire. A licensed electrician should inspect the circuit to identify the root cause.

faqs.q: When should I replace my electrical panel?
faqs.a: You should consider a panel replacement if your home is over 20 years old, if you are adding high-power appliances (like an EV charger), or if you have a dangerous brand like Federal Pacific, Stab-Lok, Sylvania, Challenger or Zinsco. Flickering lights and buzzing sounds are also major warning signs.
